verdict.rationale: Mobile approval of agent decisions is a fair question for an autonomous coding agent, but the evidence documents no approval or checkpoint workflow and no mobile app or mobile approval surface. Slack/Teams tagging, notification preferences on schedules and running parallel Devins are adjacent features that do not amount to approving key decisions from a phone while agents keep working.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working
